name: Bacon Fried Rice with Egg, Brussels Sprouts & Carrots

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. When the rice is done, remove from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.

Once the pot is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 5-6 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove crispy bacon to a paper towel-lined plate. (Reserve pot with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry Brussels sprouts; using a clean cutting board, trim and thinly slice. Place in a large bowl.
Peel, halve, and small dice onions. Add to the bowl with the Brussels sprouts along with the carrots.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
1 ½ (283 g) bags shredded carrots

instructions.primary_message: Return pot (with drippings) to medium heat, then add veggies, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring frequently, until veggies are fork-tender, 5-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are done, push to the sides of the pot and crack eggs into the middle. Let sit for a few seconds and then cook, stirring constantly, until set and no longer runny. Remove from heat.
When the rice is done, add to the pot, along with the bacon, and increase to medium-high heat. Add stir-fry sauce, stir to combine, and cook until warmed through, 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide fried rice between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
